info.longBusinessSummary: Giga-Byte Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and trades in computer hardware peripherals and components in Taiwan, Europe, America, Canada, Singapore, Japan, China, Malaysia, and internationally. It operates through Brand Business Group; and Other Business Group segments. The company offers motherboards, graphic cards, laptops, monitors, storage devices, and desktop. It also provides PC peripherals, such as keyboards, mouse products, headsets, and gaming chairs; and PC components comprising PC cases, CPU coolers, power supply products, PC accessory, and memory and SSD products, as well as DIY kits. In addition, the company offers server and workstation motherboards; AI and rack server; workstation products; direct liquid and immersion cooling; open compute project; add-in cards and expansion module; and e-mobility and embedded computing solutions. Further, it provides product solutions in storage, cloud infrastructure, cooling, software, AIoT, SMB and workstation, edge, high-performance, and AI computing, as well as server and rack-mounted computing products and integrated data centers. Giga-Byte Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
